# AGENTS & Skills Studio
AGENTS & Skills 工作台 · edit AGENTS.md, manage multiple skills, and install from four public skill cat
& Skills 工作台 · edit AGENTS.md, manage multiple skills, and install from four public skill catalogs.
AGENTS & Skills Studio is a full-page panel for DeepSeek Harness / DSH NEXT. It manages both kinds o
f workspace instruction files:

- global and workspace-root `AGENTS.md`
- multiple project skills at `<workspace>/.dsh/skills/<name>

/SKILL.md`
- the global skill directory at `$DSH_HOME/skills`
- local skill library, URL import, and
whole-directory installs from four public catalogs
Four skill sources:
| Source | Repository |

| Anthropic | `anthropics/skills` |
| OpenAI | `openai/skills` |
| Cursor | `cursor/plugins` |
| Mat
t Pocock | `mattpocock/skills` |
It also provides list and left-to-right tree views, tree search, SKILL counts, backups, conflict det
ection, and path-escape protection.
> This is a community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek product.
> 中文简介：AGENTS & Skills 工作台是一个 DSH 全页面插件，用来管理全局与工作区根 `AGENTS.md`、多个 `.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 和全局
技能目录。支持列表/横向树视图、搜索定位、SKILL 数量统计、新建/编辑/删除、URL 导入、本地技能仓库，以及从 Anthropic（`anthropics/skills`）、OpenAI（`op
enai/skills`）、Cursor（`cursor/plugins`）、Matt Pocock（`mattpocock/skills`）四源技能目录整目录安装。包含备份、外部修改冲突检测和路径逃
/skills`）、Cursor（`cursor/plugins`）、Matt Pocock（`mattpocock/skills`）四源技能目录整目录安装。包含备份、外部修改冲突检测和路径逃逸防护。
## Features

- Two views, switchable at any time:
- **List** — flat, alphabetically sorted workspaces; each works

pace shows its root `AGENTS.md` and a SKILL summary with count.
- **Tree** — a left-to-right forest

derived from workspace paths.
- Tree nodes start collapsed. Click a node to expand its children. Exp

and and collapse use a smooth 220 ms animation.
- Tree search initially lists matching nodes only. S

electing a result expands its ancestors and its complete subtree, then scrolls it into view.
- Every

tree node has `SKILL` and `AGENTS` buttons:
- green when content exists
- orange when it does not
-

`SKILL` also shows a count box
- `SKILL` opens a manager for multiple project skills:
- native skil

ls at `<workspace>/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`
- legacy root `SKILL.md` kept as a separate row
- cr

eate, edit, delete, import from a raw URL, save to the local library, install from the library
- Loc

al skill library at `$DSH_HOME/workspace-atlas/skills`.
- `AGENTS` opens the workspace root `AGENTS.

md` editor.
- Global `AGENTS.md` editor: `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`.
- Markdown text editing with LF/CRLF

and UTF-8 BOM preservation.
- `Ctrl+S` / `Cmd+S` save, `Tab` inserts two spaces.
- Unsaved-change t

racking, external-change conflict detection, reload, and delete.
- Header version button with GitHub

Release checking and one-click update through DSH Plugin Manager.
- Atomic writes and automatic bac

kups under `$DSH_HOME/agents-manager-backups/`.
- Global skill management at `$DSH_HOME/skills`.
- C
hinese and English locale, DSH theme tokens, no private Harness UI imports.
## Screenshots
## Skill catalog
The header's **Skill catalog / 技能目录** button opens a separate catalog view:

- four source cards: Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, Matt Pocock
- the catalog syncs on open and can be r

efreshed manually
- selecting a card shows that repository's skills
- each row can install into the

global skill directory or open the source directory on GitHub
- indexes are cached under `$DSH_HOME/
workspace-atlas/catalog.json`
Sources:
| Card | Repository |

| Anthropic | `anthropics/skills` |
| OpenAI | `openai/skills` |
| Cursor | `cursor/plugins` |
| Mat
t Pocock | `mattpocock/skills` |
Catalog installation downloads every file in the selected skill directory, not only `SKILL.md`. It i
nstalls into `$DSH_HOME/skills/<name>` and refuses to overwrite an existing skill.
## Create and edit skills
New skills use the Agent Skills specification:
| Field | Required | Notes |

| `name` | yes | Lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens; 1-64 characters |
| `description` |

yes | 1-1024 characters; what the skill does and when to use it |
| `license` | no | License name o

r a bundled license file |
| `compatibility` | no | Environment requirements; up to 500 characters |

| `metadata` | no | String key-value mapping |
| `allowed-tools` | no | Space-separated pre-approve

ata` | no | String key-value mapping |
| `allowed-tools` | no | Space-separated pre-approved tools |
The create form collects all six fields plus the Markdown body, then writes a canonical `SKILL.md` w
ith YAML frontmatter. Existing native skills open in the same structured editor.
The edit page has a file tab for everything outside the root `SKILL.md`:

- create nested files and folders under the skill directory
- rename the skill parent folder; all ch

ild files move with it
- edit and save text files such as `references/guide.md` or `scripts/run.py`

- delete files or folders
- path validation keeps every operation inside that skill directory
Legacy root `SKILL.md` remains a raw Markdown editor.
## Install
Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness / DSH NEXT with the Web UI and Plugin Manager
- Node.js `>=22.19.0`
Clone this repository and install the directory as a bundle in the profile used by the desktop app:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- The global/workspace `AGENTS.md` files affect the model only when `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instruct
ions` (or the active profile's equivalent loader) is enabled. In the tested desktop profile that row

was disabled.
- Editing files does not rewrite history already injected into an open Session.
- AGE
NTS & Skills Studio manages `.dsh/skills` directories directly and installs whole skill directories
from four curated catalogs; it is not a general GitHub tree browser, dependency resolver, or enable/

disable policy engine.
- URL import downloads a single `SKILL.md` only; auxiliary files must be adde

d manually.
- Legacy root `SKILL.md` remains supported for backward compatibility but is not a DSH-n
ative project skill.
